item.title: My Chemical Romance Drummer Bob Bryar Found Dead in Tennessee
item.description: The news of Bob Bryar’s passing feels like a gut punch to those who remember his explosive drumming during My Chemical Romance’s most iconic era. At just 44, Bryar was found dead in his Tennessee home on November 26.

item.title: Ozzy Osbourne Reacts to Jake E. Lee’s Shooting in Las Vegas
item.description: Ozzy Osbourne couldn’t hide his shock upon hearing that his former guitarist, Jake E. Lee, had been shot multiple times in Las Vegas early Tuesday morning (October 15).

item.title: Cliff Burton's Spirit Lives On in Metallica's Music, Says James Hetfield
item.description: James Hetfield still hears Cliff Burton’s voice. Not literally, but in his head when he’s writing music. During a recent episode of “The Metallica Report”, the frontman was asked if Cliff still influences his work.

item.title: Metallica Pays Tribute to Dedicated Fan Who Died During Edmonton Concert
item.description: Metallica paid a solemn tribute yesterday to one of their own— a dedicated fan, known as Lorne or simply “Viking,” who tragically passed away during their concert in Edmonton, Alberta.

item.title: Slipknot's Sid Wilson Injured in Fire Incident Before Rocklahoma
item.description: Slipknot’s resident turntable wizard, Sid Wilson, found himself trading the spotlight for a hospital bed after a fiery mishap involving an “explosion” left him with burns on his face and arm.
